name: sams-club-lounge-mobile
description: Native iOS and Android shell for Sams Club Lounge

scripts.assets:android: npm run assets:prepare && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath assets --iconBackgroundColor '#09050f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#09050f' --splashBackgroundColor '#09050f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#09050f'
scripts.assets:ios: npm run assets:prepare && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios --assetPath assets --iconBackgroundColor '#09050f' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#09050f' --splashBackgroundColor '#09050f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#09050f'
